title: Jacquard Cap Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at any wedding with this elegant A-line dress! Featuring a luxurious jacquard fabric, charming cap sleeves, and a flattering silhouette, this timeless piece is perfect for celebrating love in style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises jacquard.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
